Firefox lets you automatically fill in saved credit and debit card information on web forms, making online checkouts faster and more convenient. Your [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Card_security_code CVV number] is never saved, and you can require a password or biometric authentication before using autofill for extra security.

Use the steps below to turn autofill on or off, edit saved cards, and set authentication preferences.

=Require authentication for autofill=
To protect your saved payment methods, Firefox allows you to require operating system-level authentication (such as a password, fingerprint or face recognition) before filling in payment details.
#[[Template:optionspreferences]]
#Click {for not fx152}{menu Privacy & Security}{/for}{for fx152}{menu Passwords and autofill}{/for} on the left.
#Scroll down to the {for not fx145}''Autofill''{/for}{for fx145}''Payment methods''{/for} section.
#Check '''Require device sign in to autofill and manage payment methods''' to turn it on, or uncheck the box to turn it off.
{note}'''Note:''' This setting uses your computer’s password, fingerprint, face or voice login—not your Mozilla account password.{/note}

==If you don't have an OS password==
*'''Windows:''' If you aren't using a Windows password, you will not be prompted to enter it.
*'''macOS:''' If you don't have a password, click {button OK} twice to continue. '''Note:''' This is a known issue and will be fixed in a future update.
{/for}

=Edit your saved payment methods=
Use this setting to add, remove, or change saved credit or debit card data in Firefox.
#[[Template:optionspreferences]]
#Click {for not fx152}{menu Privacy & Security}{/for}{for fx152}{menu Passwords and autofill}{/for} on the left.
#Scroll down to the {for not fx145}''Autofill''{/for}{for fx145}''Payment methods''{/for} section.
#Click {for not fx145}the {button Saved payment methods} button{/for}{for fx145}{menu Manage payment methods}{/for}.
#Choose one of the following:
#*'''Add…:''' Enter a new card using this button.
#*'''Edit…:''' Select the card you want to change, then click {button Edit} to change it.
#*'''Remove:''' Select the card you want to delete, then click {button Remove}.
#Click the {button ✕} to save your changes and close the window.
